page.layout: One printed title page, single column, centred. Top to bottom: large title lines, subtitle lines in mixed sizes, a sub-title in italic, a large block of lines, a woodcut/engraving of a ship with the words "DEO GUBERNANTE" along the sun's rays, then the imprint lines below the engraving.
page.l: Doctrinam Veritatis, quæ secundum pietatem est,
eámque contra quoscunque Adversarios, Veteres & Novos,
vel in Fundamento fidei, vel circa illud errantes, ita asserens,
ut simul Historiæ Ecclesiasticæ V. & N.T. contineat Απαντωσιν,

main_text.p: JOH. HENRICI HEIDEGGERI CORPUS THEOLOGIÆ CHRISTIANÆ, exhibens Doctrinam Veritatis, quæ secundum pietatem est, eámque contra quoscunque Adversarios, Veteres & Novos, vel in Fundamento fidei, vel circa illud errantes, ita asserens, ut simul Historiæ Ecclesiasticæ V. & N.T. contineat Απαντωσιν, adeóque sit plenissimum THEOLOGIÆ DIDACTICÆ, ELENCHTICÆ, MORALIS ET HISTORICÆ Systema. TOMUS POSTERIOR. TIGURI, Typis DAVIDIS GESSNERI. MDCC.

page.notes: Copperplate engraving of a ship at sea under a hand from a cloud, with a sun and triangle, inscribed "DEO GUBERNANTE." Mixed roman, italic and capital settings; the Greek word "Απαντωσιν" is printed in the sub-title. Page number: none printed.
